cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from lib import *
import numpy as np, wave, json
meta=json.load(open('/workspace/build/meta.json'))
def render(nm,nt,vol=44,rows=64):
    m=meta['tonal'][nm]
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"v3"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":nm}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/samples/ts_%s.wav"%nm,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":m['ls'],"loop_length":m['ll'],"flags":3 if m['ll'] else 0,"volume":64,"relative_note":0}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":rows}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":nt,"instrument":1,"volume":vol}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/v3.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"loops":0})]
    run(cmds,quiet=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/v3.wav','rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); return d[:,0], sr
x,sr=render('bass',61)
seg=x[int(0.5*sr):int(4.0*sr)]
N=seg.size
win=seg*np.hanning(N)
F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(win,40*N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(40*N,1/sr)
m=(fr>60)&(fr<2500)
Fm=F.copy(); Fm[~m]=0
idx=np.argsort(Fm)[::-1][:400]
peaks=[]
for i in idx:
    f=fr[i]
    if any(abs(f-p[0])<6 for p in peaks): continue
    peaks.append((float(f),float(Fm[i]/Fm.max())))
    if len(peaks)>=14: break
peaks.sort()
print("peaks:", [(round(f,2),round(a,3)) for f,a in peaks])
print("period-169 law f0=%.2f harmonics:"%(44100/169), [round(k*44100/169,1) for k in range(1,9)])
print("ET law f0=%.2f"%(440*2**((61-69)/12)), [round(k*440*2**((61-69)/12),1) for k in range(1,9)])
# time-domain: check repetition of exact 169-sample period
print("self-similarity lag scan (best lags 100..400):")
y=seg-seg.mean()
c=np.correlate(y[:20000],y[:20000],'full')[19999:]
for lag in range(160,180):
    print("  lag",lag,round(float(c[lag]/c[169]),3))
EOF

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from lib import *
import numpy as np, wave, json
# 1) spectrum of the sample file itself (one period)
with wave.open('/workspace/samples/ts_bass.wav','rb') as f:
    raw=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
L=169
cyc=raw[:L]
F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(cyc)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(L,1/44100)
print("one-cycle spectrum (k, Hz, rel):", [(k,round(float(fr[k]),1),round(float(F[k]/F.max()),3)) for k in np.argsort(F)[::-1][:8]])
print("cycle DC mean:",round(float(cyc.mean()),4),"  file len",raw.size)
# 2) pure sine, period 169, render at note 61 and 73
tt=np.arange(169)
s=np.sin(2*np.pi*tt/169)
s16=np.int16(np.round(s*0.5*32767))
with wave.open('/workspace/build/p169.wav','wb') as f:
    f.setnchannels(1); f.setsampwidth(2); f.setframerate(44100); f.writeframes(s16.tobytes())
def rend(nt,src='/workspace/build/p169.wav'):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"p169"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"P"}),("sample_load",{"path":src,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":169,"flags":3,"volume":64,"relative_note":0}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":64}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":nt,"instrument":1,"volume":48}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/p169.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"loops":0})]
    run(cmds,quiet=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/p169.wav','rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); return d[:,0], sr
for nt in [61,73,49]:
    x,sr=rend(nt)
    seg=x[int(1.0*sr):int(4.0*sr)]
    N=seg.size
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(N),60*N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(60*N,1/sr)
    mx=F.max()
    # top 6 distinct peaks
    idx=np.argsort(F)[::-1][:2000]; pk=[]
    for i in idx:
        f=fr[i]
        if f<10: continue
        if any(abs(f-p)<5 for p in pk): continue
        pk.append(float(f))
        if len(pk)>=6: break
    pk.sort()
    print("note %d: peaks %s (expect %.2f)"%(nt,[round(v,2) for v in pk], 44100/169*2**((nt-61)/12)))
EOF"}

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from lib import *
import numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
def mkfile(n, f=260.95, path=None):
    t=np.arange(n)/SR
    x=0.5*np.sin(2*np.pi*f*t)
    # whole-cycle-ish: choose f so that n cycles fit exactly
    cyc=n/(SR/f)
    x=0.5*np.sin(2*np.pi*(round(cyc))*np.arange(n)/n)
    p=path or '/workspace/build/len_test.wav'
    xi=np.int16(np.round(x*32767))
    with wave.open(p,'wb') as f2:
        f2.setnchannels(1);f2.setsampwidth(2);f2.setframerate(SR);f2.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
    return p, SR/ (n/round(cyc))
def probe(n, note=61, loop=True, tag="lt"):
    p,fact=mkfile(n)
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":tag}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"X"}),("sample_load",{"path":p,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":(n if loop else 0),"flags":3 if loop else 0,"volume":64,"relative_note":0}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":64}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":note,"instrument":1,"volume":48}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/%s_out.wav"%tag,"rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0})]
    run(cmds,quiet=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/%s_out.wav'%tag,'rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x=d[:,0]
    seg=x[int(0.5*sr):int(2.5*sr)]
    z=np.nonzero(np.diff(np.signbit(seg)))[0]

    for i in range(patnum):
        plen=ptr[i]
        if plen==0 or plen>=len(d): pats.append(None); continue
        q=plen
        rows=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,q+7)[0]
        npack=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,q+9)[0]
        pats.append((q,rows,npack))

        for row in range(rows):

                p8=d[r]
                if p8&0x80:

        for row in range(rows):

                p8=d[r]

                    n1=d[r+1]; n2=d[r+2]; r+=3+n1+n2
                else: r+=p8
        ipos=r
    else:

            gsz=struct.unpack_from('<I',ib,ext)[0]
            print("    ext size",gsz)
            sp=ipos+ilen
            for s in range(ns):

                vol=sh[12]; fin=sh[13]; rv=sh[14]; lmode=sh[15]; nm=bytes(sh[16:36]).strip(b'\x00').decode()
                c2=struct.unpack_from('<I',sh,36)[0]
                print("    samp%d len=%d loop=(%d,%d) mode=%d vol=%d fine=%d c2spd=%d name=%s"%(s,slen,loopst,looplen,lmode,vol,fin,c2,nm))
                if lmode&16==0:

    return d

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from lib import *
import numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
def mk(path, nsamp, cycles=8, amp=0.4):
    n=int(nsamp)
    x=amp*np.sin(2*np.pi*cycles*np.arange(n)/n)
    xi=np.int16(np.round(x*32767))
    with wave.open(path,'wb') as f:
        f.setnchannels(1);f.setsampwidth(2);f.setframerate(SR);f.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
    return n, SR*cycles/n
def probe(path,n,ll=None,ls=0):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"pz"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"P"}),("sample_load",{"path":path,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":ls,"loop_length":(ll if ll is not None else 0),"flags":3 if ll else 0,"volume":64}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":32}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":61,"instrument":1,"volume":40}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/pz_out.wav","rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0})]
    run(cmds,quiet=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/pz_out.wav','rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x=d[:,0]
    seg=x[int(0.5*sr):int(2.0*sr)]
    zc=np.nonzero(np.diff(np.signbit(seg)))[0]
    per=np.median(np.diff(zc))*2 if zc.size>5 else 0
    return sr/per if per else 0, np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2))
for nsamp,cyc in [(2028,12),(4410,26),(8820,52),(22050,130),(44100,260)]:
    p='/workspace/build/pz_src.wav'
    n,fact=mk(p,nsamp,cyc)
    f0,rms=probe(p)
    f0b,rmsb=probe(p,0,nsamp)
    print("n=%6d cyc=%3d file_f=%7.1f | noloop->%7.1f rms%.3f | loop(0,%d)->%7.1f rms%.3f"%(n,cyc,fact,f0,rms,nsamp,f0b,rmsb))
EOF

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from lib import *
import numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
def one(path,note,vol=32,ll=SR,tag="c4"):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":tag}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"P"}),("sample_load",{"path":path,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":ll,"flags":3,"volume":64}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":32}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":note,"instrument":1,"volume":vol}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/%s_out.wav"%tag,"rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0})]
    run(cmds,quiet=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/%s_out.wav'%tag,'rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x=d[:,0]
    seg=x[int(0.5*sr):int(2.0*sr)]
    N=seg.size
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(N)))*2/N
    fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
    top=np.argsort(F)[::-1][:6]
    pk=sorted([(round(float(fr[i]),1),round(float(F[i]),4)) for i in top if F[i]>0.003])
    print("  peak=%.3f rms=%.4f"%(np.max(np.abs(seg)),np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2))), pk)
for p,expect in [('/workspace/build/A_ref.wav',440),('/workspace/build/B_own.wav',440),('/workspace/build/C_260.wav',260)]:
    print(p.split('/')[-1])
    for note in [61,69]:
        print("   note",note,"law(n-61)=%.1f law(n-69)=%.1f ->"%(expect*2**((note-61)/12),expect*2**((note-69)/12)))
        one(p,note)
EOF"}

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from lib import *
import numpy as np, wave, time, json
SR=44100
# clean periodic bass sample: period 169 (base note 61 => 260.9 Hz), 88 cycles
L=169
tt=np.arange(88*L)
def lpf(x,c):
    y=np.empty_like(x); a=0.0
    for i in range(x.size): a+=c*(x[i]-a); y[i]=a
    return y
x=np.zeros(tt.size)
for k in range(1,22):
    x+= (1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/9.0)*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*tt/L)
x=lpf(x,0.42); x=lpf(x,0.55); x=np.tanh(2.2*x)
loop=x[70*L:].reshape(18,L).mean(0); loop-=loop.mean()
sig=np.tile(loop,4)
xi=np.int16(np.round(sig/np.max(np.abs(sig))*0.9*32767))
with wave.open('/workspace/build/bass_test.wav','wb') as f:
    f.setnchannels(1);f.setsampwidth(2);f.setframerate(SR);f.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
print("file len",xi.size,"loop period",L)
cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"bl"}),
 ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"B"}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/build/bass_test.wav","instrument":1,"sample":0}),
 ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":3*L,"flags":3,"volume":64}),
 ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":32}),
 ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":45,"instrument":1,"volume":44}),
 ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
 ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/bl_out.wav","rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0})]
run(cmds,quiet=True)
with wave.open('/workspace/build/bl_out.wav','rb') as f:
    nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x2=d[:,0]
seg=x2[int(0.5*sr):int(3.0*sr)]
N=seg.size; F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(N)))*2/N; fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
print("duration %.2f, rms=%.3f"%(x2.size/sr, np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2))))
for k in range(1,6):
    fq=260.95*2**((45-61)/12)*k
    i=np.argmin(np.abs(fr-fq)); print("   harm %d at %.1f: amp %.4f"%(k,fq,np.max(F[max(0,i-2):i+3])))
# discontinuity check: look for large jumps
dd=np.abs(np.diff(seg))
print("   max jump %.4f  (signal peak %.3f) -> click-free if jump ~ normal slew"%(dd.max(),np.max(np.abs(seg))))
# batch throughput
t0=time.time()
big=[("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":1,"rows":64})]
for r in range(64):
    for c in range(8):
        big.append(("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":1,"row":r,"channel":c,"note":60,"instrument":1,"volume":40}))
run(big,quiet=True)
print("2049 cell calls: %.2f s"%(time.time()-t0))
EOF"}

cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from lib import *
import numpy as np, wave, time, json
SR=44100
# clean periodic bass sample: period 169 (base note 61 => 260.9 Hz), 88 cycles
L=169
tt=np.arange(88*L)
def lpf(x,c):
    y=np.empty_like(x); a=0.0
    for i in range(x.size): a+=c*(x[i]-a); y[i]=a
    return y
x=np.zeros(tt.size)
for k in range(1,22):
    x+= (1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/9.0)*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*tt/L)
x=lpf(x,0.42); x=lpf(x,0.55); x=np.tanh(2.2*x)
loop=x[70*L:].reshape(18,L).mean(0); loop-=loop.mean()
sig=np.tile(loop,4)
xi=np.int16(np.round(sig/np.max(np.abs(sig))*0.9*32767))
with wave.open('/workspace/build/bass_test.wav','wb') as f:
    f.setnchannels(1);f.setsampwidth(2);f.setframerate(SR);f.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
print("file len",xi.size,"loop period",L)
cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"bl"}),
 ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"B"}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/build/bass_test.wav","instrument":1,"sample":0}),
 ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":3*L,"flags":3,"volume":64}),
 ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":32}),
 ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":45,"instrument":1,"volume":44}),
 ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
 ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/bl_out.wav","rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0})]
run(cmds,quiet=True)
with wave.open('/workspace/build/bl_out.wav','rb') as f:
    nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x2=d[:,0]
seg=x2[int(0.5*sr):int(3.0*sr)]
N=seg.size; F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(N)))*2/N; fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
print("duration %.2f, rms=%.3f"%(x2.size/sr, np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2))))
for k in range(1,6):
    fq=260.95*2**((45-61)/12)*k
    i=np.argmin(np.abs(fr-fq)); print("   harm %d at %.1f: amp %.4f"%(k,fq,np.max(F[max(0,i-2):i+3])))
# discontinuity check: look for large jumps
dd=np.abs(np.diff(seg))
print("   max jump %.4f  (signal peak %.3f) -> click-free if jump ~ normal slew"%(dd.max(),np.max(np.abs(seg))))
# batch throughput
t0=time.time()
big=[("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":1,"rows":64})]
for r in range(64):
    for c in range(8):
        big.append(("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":1,"row":r,"channel":c,"note":60,"instrument":1,"volume":40}))
run(big,quiet=True)
print("2049 cell calls: %.2f s"%(time.time()-t0))
EOF

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
from lib import *
import numpy as np, wave
SR=44100; L=169; K=260
def lpf(x,c):
    y=np.empty_like(x); a=0.0
    for i in range(x.size): a+=c*(x[i]-a); y[i]=a
    return y
N=L*K
tt=np.arange(N)
x=np.zeros(N)
for k in range(1,22):
    x+=(1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/9.0)*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*tt/L)
x=lpf(x,0.42); x=lpf(x,0.55); x=np.tanh(2.2*x)
# steady-state: average aligned cycles over whole file
nc=N//L
loop=x[80*L:].reshape(nc-80,L).mean(0); loop-=loop.mean()
sig=np.tile(loop,K)
peak=np.max(np.abs(sig)); sig=sig/peak*0.9
xi=np.int16(np.round(sig*32767))
with wave.open('/workspace/build/bass_big.wav','wb') as f:
    f.setnchannels(1);f.setsampwidth(2);f.setframerate(SR);f.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
print("file",xi.size,"peak->0.9")
for note in [45,57,61,76]:
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"bb"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"B"}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/build/bass_big.wav","instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":xi.size,"flags":3,"volume":64}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":32}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":note,"instrument":1,"volume":44}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/bb_out.wav","rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0})]
    run(cmds,quiet=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/bb_out.wav','rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x2=d[:,0]
    seg=x2[int(0.5*sr):int(3.0*sr)]
    N2=seg.size; F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(N2)))*2/N2; fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N2,1/sr)
    f0=260.95*2**((note-61)/12)
    amps=[]
    for k in range(1,9):
        i=np.argmin(np.abs(fr-f0*k)); amps.append(round(float(np.max(F[max(0,i-2):i+3])),4))
    print("note %2d f0=%6.1f peak=%.3f rms=%.3f  harm1..8=%s"%(note,f0,np.max(np.abs(seg)),np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2)),amps))
EOF

"""Final sample material. Static periodic waveforms (period P samples, exact integer)
   + synthesized percussion. Engine law: f = (SR/P)*2^((note-61)/12), so one P for all
   tonal instruments keeps everything mutually in tune."""
import numpy as np, os, wave, json
SR=44100.0
OUT='/workspace/samples'; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
rng=np.random.RandomState(20240107)
P=169          # 44100/169 = 260.9 Hz at note 61 (C-5); A4 = note 58
def save(name,x,peak=0.9):
    x=np.asarray(x,float); m=np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    xi=np.int16(np.clip(np.round(x/m*peak*32767),-32768,32767))
    with wave.open(os.path.join(OUT,name+'.wav'),'wb') as f:
        f.setnchannels(1);f.setsampwidth(2);f.setframerate(int(SR));f.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
    return int(xi.size)
def lpf(x,c):
    y=np.empty_like(x); a=0.0
    for i in range(x.size):
        a+=c*(x[i]-a); y[i]=a
    return y
def hpf(x,c): return x-lpf(x,c)
def svf_low(x,f0,res=0.4):
    F=min(2*np.sin(np.pi*float(np.clip(f0,20,SR*0.45))/SR),0.9); d=2*(1-res)
    low=0.0; band=0.0; out=np.empty_like(x)
    for i in range(x.size):
        high=x[i]-low-d*band
        band=F*high+band; low=F*band+low; out[i]=low
    return out
def svf_band(x,f0,Q=0.8):
    F=min(2*np.sin(np.pi*float(np.clip(f0,20,SR*0.45))/SR),0.9); d=1.0/max(Q,0.5)
    low=0.0; band=0.0; out=np.empty_like(x)
    for i in range(x.size):
        high=x[i]-low-d*band
        band=F*high+band; low=F*band+low; out[i]=band*0.6
    return out
def nz(n): return rng.randn(int(n))
def steady(harm, period=P, ops=None, cycles=64, settle=8, phases=None):
    tt=np.arange(cycles*period)
    x=np.zeros(tt.size)
    for k,a in harm.items():
        if a: x+=a*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*tt/period+(phases or {}).get(k,0.0))
    for op in (ops or []):
        t0=op[0]
        if t0=='lp': x=lpf(x,op[1])
        elif t0=='hp': x=hpf(x,op[1])
        elif t0=='tanh': x=np.tanh(op[1]*x)
        elif t0=='lpl': x=svf_low(x,op[1],op[2] if len(op)>2 else 0.4)
        elif t0=='bp': x=svf_band(x,op[1],op[2] if len(op)>2 else 0.8)
    nc=cycles-settle
    loop=x[settle*period:][:nc*period].reshape(nc,period).mean(0)
    loop-=loop.mean()
    return loop
def loopfile(name, loop, ncyc, peak=0.9):
    sig=np.tile(loop,int(ncyc))
    return dict(file=name+'.wav', len=int(sig.size), ls=0, ll=int(sig.size), ncyc=int(ncyc),
                period=P, rel=0, peak=peak)

# ---------------- tonal timbres ----------------
def tonal():
    T={}
    saw=lambda rolloff, kmax=26: {k:(1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/rolloff) for k in range(1,kmax+1)}
    # 1 BASS: fat lowpassed saw + sub emphasis
    h=saw(7.5); h[1]*=1.25; h[2]*=1.15
    lb=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.38),('lp',0.52),('tanh',2.2)],cycles=72)
    T['bass']=loopfile('b_fat',lb,30)
    # 2 SUBBASS: sine + slight 2nd (for breakdown / pickups)
    h={1:1.0,2:0.22,3:0.06}
    ls=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.30)],cycles=72)
    T['sub']=loopfile('b_sub',ls,30)
    # 3 LEAD: bright rich saw, doubled phase
    h=saw(6.0); h[2]*=1.1
    l1=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.55),('lp',0.72),('tanh',1.7)],cycles=72)
    l2=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.5),('lp',0.7)],cycles=72,phases={k:0.35*np.sin(k) for k in h})
    loop=0.62*l1+0.62*l2
    T['lead']=loopfile('l_fat',loop,26)
    # 4 SOFT/FLUTE lead (sine+few) for counters & bridge
    h={1:1.0,2:0.30,3:0.10,4:0.04}
    l1=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.35)],cycles=72)
    l2=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.3)],cycles=72,phases={2:0.8,3:1.6})
    T['soft']=loopfile('l_soft',0.6*l1+0.6*l2,26)
    # 5 PAD: heavily lowpassed saw, long cycles
    h=saw(4.5); h[1]*=1.3
    lp=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.16),('lp',0.24),('lp',0.4)],cycles=80)
    lp2=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.14),('lp',0.22)],cycles=80,phases={k:0.6*k for k in h})
    T['pad']=loopfile('p_soft',0.6*lp+0.6*lp2,44)
    # 6 SYNC/ACID: resonant lowpass saw (bridge drive)
    h={k:1.0/k for k in range(1,24)}
    for k in [3,5,7,9]: h[k]*1.7
    l=steady(h,ops=[('lpl',520,0.9),('tanh',2.6),('lp',0.7)],cycles=72)
    T['sync']=loopfile('b_sync',l,30)
    # 7 STEEL/metallic pluck layer (odd partials) for arp/bridge
    h={1:1.0,3:0.55,5:0.36,7:0.26,9:0.18,11:0.13,13:0.09,15:0.07,17:0.05,19:0.035,21:0.025}
    l=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.6),('tanh',1.5)],cycles=72)
    T['steel']=loopfile('m_steel',l,34)
    # 8 HARPSI: plucky loop with fast-decaying upper partials
    h={k:(1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/6.0)*(2.0 if k in (2,3) else 1.0) for k in range(1,20)}
    l=steady(h,ops=[('lp',0.45),('tanh',2.0)],cycles=72)
    T['harpsi']=loopfile('h_harpsi',l,26)
    return T

# ---------------- shots ----------------
def shots():
    S={}
    def shape(x, a_len, d_exp, peak=0.9, afade=0.0015, tfade=0.004):
        n=x.size
        t=np.arange(n)/SR
        e=np.exp(-t/a_len)*np.exp(-(t/a_len)**1.3)
        y=x*e
        na=int(afade*SR); nt=int(tfade*SR)
        y[:na]*=np.linspace(0,1,na)
        y[-nt:]*=(1-np.linspace(0,1,nt))**1.5
        return save_arr(y,peak)
    def save_arr(y,peak):
        m=np.max(np.abs(y)) or 1.0
        return np.int16(np.clip(np.round(y/m*peak*32767),-32768,32767))
    # ARP pluck: harmonic-independent 1/k^0.9 decay, 0.5 s
    def pluck(harm, kmax, decay, tail, bright=1.0, sub=0.0):
        n=int(tail*SR); t=np.arange(n)/SR
        o=np.zeros(n)
        for k in range(1,kmax+1):
            a=harm(k)
            o+=a*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*(SR/P)*t)*np.exp(-t/(decay/(k**0.9)))
        o+= sub*np.sin(2*np.pi*(SR/P)*t)*np.exp(-t/(decay*1.8))
        o=lpf(o,bright); return o
    p=pluck(lambda k:(1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/11.0)*(1.4 if k in (2,3) else 1.0), 24, 0.052, 0.46, 0.62, 0.35)
    S['arp']=dict(len=int(p.size), data=save_arr(p,0.9))
    # BRASS STAB (looped-ish shot with fast attack/hold/release)
    n=int(0.42*SR); t=np.arange(n)/SR
    h=saw_=({k:(1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/5.0) for k in range(1,22)})
    base=np.zeros(n)
    for k,a in h.items():
        base+=a*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*(SR/P)*t)
    base=lpf(base,0.5); base=lpf(base,0.62); base=np.tanh(1.6*base)
    att=int(0.012*SR); rel=int(0.16*SR); hold=n-att-rel
    e=np.concatenate([np.linspace(0,1,att)**0.7, np.full(hold,0.92), (1-np.linspace(0,1,rel+1))[1:]**1.2])
    ns=np.sign(np.sin(2*np.pi*230*t))*0.06
    stab=(base*(1+0.0))*(e)+ns*e*0.4
    S['stab']=dict(len=int(stab.size), data=save_arr(stab,0.9))
    # TOM tuned shot / ROTO
    n=int(0.5*SR); t=np.arange(n)/SR
    f=210*np.exp(-t/0.2)+120
    ph=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/SR
    body=np.sin(ph)
    for k in (2,3,4):
        body+= (0.4/k)*np.sin(k*ph)
    nz=svf_band(nz(n),1800,0.9)*0.25
    e=np.exp(-t/0.17)
    tom=body*e+nz*np.exp(-t/0.05)
    S['tom']=dict(len=int(tom.size), data=save_arr(tom,0.9))
    return S

"""Final sample material. Static periodic waveforms (period P samples, exact integer)
   + synthesized percussion. Engine law: f = (SR/P)*2^((note-61)/12), so one P for all
   tonal instruments keeps everything mutually in tune."""
import numpy as np, os, wave, json
SR=44100.0
OUT='/workspace/samples'; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
rng=np.random.RandomState(20240107)
P=169          # 44100/169 = 260.9 Hz at note 61 (C-5); A4 = note 58
def save(name,x,peak=0.9):
    x=np.asarray(x,float); m=np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    xi=np.int16(np.clip(np.round(x/m*peak*32767),-32768,32767))
    with wave.open(os.path.join(OUT,name+'.wav'),'wb') as f:
        f.setnchannels(1);f.setsampwidth(2);f.setframerate(int(SR));f.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
    return int(xi.size)
def lpf(x,c):
    y=np.empty_like(x); a=0.0
    for i in range(x.size):
        a+=c*(x[i]-a); y[i]=a
    return y
def hpf(x,c): return x-lpf(x,c)
def svf_low(x,f0,res=0.4):
    F=min(2*np.sin(np.pi*float(np.clip(f0,20,SR*0.45))/SR),0.9); d=2*(1-res)
    low=0.0; band=0.0; out=np.empty_like(x)
    for i in range(x.size):
        high=x[i]-low-d*band
        band=F*high+band; low=F*band+low; out[i]=low
    return out
def svf_band(x,f0,Q=0.8):
    F=min(2*np.sin(np.pi*float(np.clip(f0,20,SR*0.45))/SR),0.9); d=1.0/max(Q,0.5)
    low=0.0; band=0.0; out=np.empty_like(x)
    for i in range(x.size):
        high=x[i]-low-d*band
        band=F*high+band; low=F*band+low; out[i]=band*0.6
    return out
def nz(n): return rng.randn(int(n))
def steady(harm, period=P, ops=None, cycles=64, settle=8, phases=None):
    tt=np.arange(cycles*period)
    x=np.zeros(tt.size)
    for k,a in harm.items():
        if a: x+=a*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*tt/period+(phases or {}).get(k,0.0))
    for op in (ops or []):
        t0=op[0]
        if t0=='lp': x=lpf(x,op[1])
        elif t0=='hp': x=hpf(x,op[1])
        elif t0=='tanh': x=np.tanh(op[1]*x)
        elif t0=='lpl': x=svf_low(x,op[1],op[2] if len(op)>2 else 0.4)
        elif t0=='bp': x=svf_band(x,op[1],op[2] if len(op)>2 else 0.8)
    nc=cycles-settle
    loop=x[settle*period:][:nc*period].reshape(nc,period).mean(0)
    loop-=loop.mean()
    return loop
def loopfile(name, loop, ncyc, peak=0.9):
    sig=np.tile(loop,int(ncyc))
    return dict(file=name+'.wav', len=int(sig.size), ls=0, ll=int(sig.size), ncyc=int(ncyc),
                period=P, rel=0, peak=peak)
PYEOF

# ---------------- shots (single wave files) ----------------
def i16(y,peak=0.9):
    y=np.asarray(y,float); m=np.max(np.abs(y)) or 1.0
    return np.int16(np.clip(np.round(y/m*peak*32767),-32768,32767))
def shots():
    S={}
    def wfile(name,y,peak=0.9):
        xi=i16(y,peak)
        with wave.open(os.path.join(OUT,name+'.wav'),'wb') as f:
            f.setnchannels(1);f.setsampwidth(2);f.setframerate(int(SR));f.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
        S[name]=int(xi.size)
    F0=SR/P
    # ARP pluck
    n=int(0.46*SR); t=np.arange(n)/SR
    o=np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1,25):
        a=(1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/11.0)*(1.4 if k in (2,3) else 1.0)
        o+=a*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*F0*t)*np.exp(-t/(0.052/(k**0.9)))
    o+=0.35*np.sin(2*np.pi*F0*t)*np.exp(-t/0.093)
    o=lpf(o,0.62)
    wfile('s_arp',o,0.9)
    # BRASS STAB
    n=int(0.44*SR); t=np.arange(n)/SR
    base=np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1,22):
        base+=(1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/5.0)*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*F0*t)
    base=lpf(base,0.5); base=lpf(base,0.62); base=np.tanh(1.6*base)
    att=int(0.010*SR); rel=int(0.17*SR); hold=max(0,n-att-rel)
    e=np.concatenate([np.linspace(0,1,att)**0.7, np.full(hold,0.93), (1-np.linspace(0,1,rel+1))[1:]**1.2])
    wfile('s_stab',base*e,0.9)
    # SOFT PAD shot (slow swell 1 bar)
    n=int(1.7*SR); t=np.arange(n)/SR
    b=np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1,13):
        b+=(1.0/k)*np.exp(-k/4.0)*np.sin(2*np.pi*k*F0*t)
    b=lpf(b,0.2); b=lpf(b,0.3)
    e=(np.sin(np.pi*np.linspace(0,1,n))**1.4)
    wfile('s_swell',b*e,0.85)
    # TROTB tuned shot for fills (higher pitched tom)

"""Composition data for 'Neon Circuit' - chord progressions, voice leading, arrangement."""
PC={'C':1,'C#':2,'D':3,'D#':4,'E':5,'F':6,'F#':7,'G':8,'G#':9,'A':10,'A#':11,'B':12}
def i(name):
    n=name[:-2]; o=int(name[-1]); return 12*o+PC[n]
def nm(idx):
    inv={v:k for k,v in PC.items()}
    return "%s-%d"%(inv[((idx-1)%12)+1],(idx-1)//12)

# --- chord table: (root, quality) per bar, 4 chords/bar, roman roots in A minor ---

# ---------- voice-leading / pattern generators ----------
def bass_walk(prog, bar, style='drive'):
    """returns list of (row, note_idx, vol) for one bar (12 rows)."""
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    R=root
    P5=R+7; OCT=R+12; SUB=R-5
    if style=='drive':   # gallop 8ths + 16th pickups
        pat=[(0,R,50),(2,R,44),(3,OCT,42),(4,R,46),(6,R,44),(7,OCT,42),(8,R,46),(10,SUB,44)]
    elif style=='hold':
        pat=[(0,R,50),(6,R,48)]
    elif style=='off':   # offbeat stabs
        pat=[(1,R,46),(3,OCT,40),(5,R,44),(7,OCT,40),(9,R,46),(11,OCT,38)]
    elif style=='walk':  # walking 4ths with approach notes
        n5=dia(R,4); n3=dia(R,2)
        pat=[(0,R,48),(3,n3,44),(6,n5,44),(9,dia(n5+12,-2),42)]
    elif style=='punk':
        pat=[(0,R,50),(2,R,46),(4,R,46),(6,R,50),(8,R,46),(10,R,46)]
    else:
        pat=[(0,R,48)]
    return [(r,n,v) for r,n,v in pat]

def bass_sub(prog, bar, style='hold'):
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    R=root
    if style=='hold': return [(0,R,42)]
    if style=='pulse': return [(r,R,40) for r in (0,3,6,9)]
    return [(0,R,42)]

def arp_shape(prog, bar, shape='up', oct=0, vol=42):
    """16th arpeggio of chord triad over one bar -> (row, note, vol)"""
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    notes=[t+12*oct for t in tri]
    if shape=='up':   seq=notes+[notes[0]+12]
    elif shape=='ud': seq=notes+[notes[0]+12]+notes[::-1][1:-1]
    elif shape=='down': seq=list(reversed(notes))+[notes[-1]-12]
    else: seq=notes
    ev=[]
    for k in range(12):
        n=seq[k%len(seq)]
        v=vol-(4 if k%4==0 else 0) if k%4==0 else vol-6
        ev.append((k,n,v))
    return ev

def arp_8th(prog, bar, shape='up', oct=0, vol=42):
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    notes=[t+12*oct for t in tri]
    seq=notes if shape=='up' else list(reversed(notes))
    ev=[]
    for k in range(6):
        n=seq[k%len(seq)]+(12 if k>=3 else 0)
        ev.append((k*2,n,vol-(3 if k%2 else 0)))
    return ev

def pad_voicing(prog, bar, voic='A'):
    """3 sustained notes for one bar; returns list of 3 note idx"""
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    if voic=='A':
        return tri
    if voic=='B':  # first inversion-ish, higher
        return [tri[1],tri[2],tri[0]+12]
    if voic=='C':  # wide
        return [tri[0],tri[1]+12,tri[2]+12]
    return tri

def lead_events(prog, mel, bar, transpose=0):
    """mel entries are (name,dur) laid onto rows 0..11 sequentially"""
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    ev=[]; r=0
    for name,dur in mel[bar%len(mel)]:
        if r>11: break
        ev.append((r,i(name)+transpose,dur))
        r+=dur
    return ev

# ---------- voice-leading / pattern generators ----------
def bass_walk(prog, bar, style='drive'):
    """returns list of (row, note_idx, vol) for one bar (12 rows)."""
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    R=root
    P5=R+7; OCT=R+12; SUB=R-5
    if style=='drive':   # gallop 8ths + 16th pickups
        pat=[(0,R,50),(2,R,44),(3,OCT,42),(4,R,46),(6,R,44),(7,OCT,42),(8,R,46),(10,SUB,44)]
    elif style=='hold':
        pat=[(0,R,50),(6,R,48)]
    elif style=='off':   # offbeat stabs
        pat=[(1,R,46),(3,OCT,40),(5,R,44),(7,OCT,40),(9,R,46),(11,OCT,38)]
    elif style=='walk':  # walking 4ths with approach notes
        n5=dia(R,4); n3=dia(R,2)
        pat=[(0,R,48),(3,n3,44),(6,n5,44),(9,dia(n5+12,-2),42)]
    elif style=='punk':
        pat=[(0,R,50),(2,R,46),(4,R,46),(6,R,50),(8,R,46),(10,R,46)]
    else:
        pat=[(0,R,48)]
    return [(r,n,v) for r,n,v in pat]

def bass_sub(prog, bar, style='hold'):
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    R=root
    if style=='hold': return [(0,R,42)]
    if style=='pulse': return [(r,R,40) for r in (0,3,6,9)]
    return [(0,R,42)]

def arp_shape(prog, bar, shape='up', oct=0, vol=42):
    """16th arpeggio of chord triad over one bar -> (row, note, vol)"""
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    notes=[t+12*oct for t in tri]
    if shape=='up':   seq=notes+[notes[0]+12]
    elif shape=='ud': seq=notes+[notes[0]+12]+notes[::-1][1:-1]
    elif shape=='down': seq=list(reversed(notes))+[notes[-1]-12]
    else: seq=notes
    ev=[]
    for k in range(12):
        n=seq[k%len(seq)]
        v=vol-(4 if k%4==0 else 0) if k%4==0 else vol-6
        ev.append((k,n,v))
    return ev

def arp_8th(prog, bar, shape='up', oct=0, vol=42):
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    notes=[t+12*oct for t in tri]
    seq=notes if shape=='up' else list(reversed(notes))
    ev=[]
    for k in range(6):
        n=seq[k%len(seq)]+(12 if k>=3 else 0)
        ev.append((k*2,n,vol-(3 if k%2 else 0)))
    return ev

def pad_voicing(prog, bar, voic='A'):
    """3 sustained notes for one bar; returns list of 3 note idx"""
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    if voic=='A':
        return tri
    if voic=='B':  # first inversion-ish, higher
        return [tri[1],tri[2],tri[0]+12]
    if voic=='C':  # wide
        return [tri[0],tri[1]+12,tri[2]+12]
    return tri

def lead_events(prog, mel, bar, transpose=0):
    """mel entries are (name,dur) laid onto rows 0..11 sequentially"""
    ch,q,root,tri=chord_notes(prog,bar)
    ev=[]; r=0
    for name,dur in mel[bar%len(mel)]:
        if r>11: break
        ev.append((r,i(name)+transpose,dur))
        r+=dur
    return ev

{"command": "cat >> /workspace/build/song.py << 'PYEOF'

# ---------------- arrangement ----------------
ROWS=12            # rows per bar
BAR_PAT=2          # bars per pattern
# amplitude model: final = 0.84 * (v-16)/48   (v<17 => silent)
def vol(amp, trim=1.0):
    a=amp/trim
    v=16+48*max(0.0,min(1.0,a))
    return max(0,int(round(v))) if v>16.4 else 0
TRIM={'bass':1.00,'sub':0.95,'arp':1.05,'steel':1.00,'pad':0.92,'lead':0.98,'soft':1.00,
      'stab':1.05,'sync':1.00,'kick':1.30,'snare':1.15,'clap':1.15,'hatc':1.4,'fato':1.3,
      'shak':1.5,'hit':1.4,'tom':1.2,'ltom':1.2,'crash':1.5,'riser':1.6,'swell':1.0}

def tie(notes):
    """(row,note,dur) -> cells with note and keyoff"""
    ev=[]
    for r,n,d in notes:
        ev.append(('n',r,n,d))
    return ev

class Builder:
    def __init__(self, chans):
        self.chans=chans          # dict name->channel index
        self.patterns=[]          # list of (list of cells) per pattern; cells: (row,ch,note,inst,vol,off?)
        self.order=[]
    def new_pattern(self):
        self.patterns.append([])
        return len(self.patterns)-1
    def add(self,pat,row,ch,note,inst,v,off=None):
        self.patterns[pat].append((row,ch,note,inst,v))
        if off is not None:
            self.patterns[pat].append((row+off,ch,97,0,0))
    def bar_events(self, pat, bar_in_pat, ev, ch, inst, trim, sustain=False):
        """ev: list of (row,note,amp) single shots  or (row,note,dur) for sustained"""
        off=bar_in_pat*ROWS
        for e in ev:
            r,n,a=e[0],e[1],e[2]
            v=vol(a,TRIM[inst] if inst in TRIM else 1.0)
            if v<=0: continue
            if len(e)>3:      # sustained with duration
                d=e[3]
                self.add(pat,off+r,ch,n,inst,v,off=min(d,ROWS-r))
            else:
                self.add(pat,off+r,ch,n,inst,v)

Now the arrangement. I need to define, per song section (each section = 8 bars = 6 patterns), which voices/channels are active, what drum/bass/arp/lead/pad patterns are used.

Let me define the arrangement as a list of sections. Each section has per-bar settings. Rather than making one pattern per bar with everything, I'll use "bar patterns" per channel group:
- Drum patterns: I'll generate a handful of drum patterns (each 12 rows = 1 bar) per "bar type" (intro, verse-a, verse-b, chorus-a, chorus-b, fill variants). Since chord-dependent content lives in other channels, drums can be shared across bars — good for pattern reuse.
- Perc/shaker patterns similar.
- Bass patterns: chord-dependent (notes), so a new pattern per bar... unless I generate bass patterns per section-bar combination. To keep pattern count reasonable, generate one pattern per bar per group where needed: e.g., for an 8-bar verse: bass patterns 0..7 unique? Bass uses the same rhythm style per bar; only notes change. So 8 bars × 1 pattern = 8 patterns for bass. Plus arp: 8 patterns. Lead/pad: 8 patterns each.

If I put bass on 1 channel and arp on 1 channel in the same pattern, they share the pattern → good: pattern contains channels for bass, arp, lead, pad, drums... but then each bar needs its own full pattern (drum content would also be per-bar). Pattern count = number of bars in song = 128, each 12 rows × 16 channels = 192 events → 24576 calls, fine at 0.04s per 2000 calls (fast). Pattern rows 12 each.

Hmm, but with one pattern per bar, patterns can't be reused across similar sections — that's fine musically (arrangement handled explicitly). But it makes the module less "tracker-like" (real keygen modules reuse patterns). Middle ground: reuse at phrase level: create per-section bar patterns where each pattern holds the harmonic channels (bass, arps, pad, lead) for that bar and separate shared drum patterns are used... but a pattern in the order lists ALL channels simultaneously; the channel→pattern mapping is global per pattern. In FT2 (and this engine), each pattern has a fixed number of channels (song channels), so a "drum channel" lives at the same channel index in every pattern. So if drums are in pattern P at channel 14, and I want to reuse drum content across sections, I must copy it into each bar pattern anyway.

Alternative: dedicate some patterns to drums only (harmonic channels empty) and interleave in the order: no, that doesn't work since patterns play simultaneously across all channels — a drum-only pattern would silence harmonics.

cat >> /workspace/build/song.py << 'PYEOF'

# ---------------- arrangement ----------------
ROWS=12            # rows per bar
BAR_PAT=2          # bars per pattern
# amplitude model: final = 0.84 * (v-16)/48   (v<17 => silent)
def vol(amp, trim=1.0):
    a=amp/trim
    v=16+48*max(0.0,min(1.0,a))
    return max(0,int(round(v))) if v>16.4 else 0
TRIM={'bass':1.00,'sub':0.95,'arp':1.05,'steel':1.00,'pad':0.92,'lead':0.98,'soft':1.00,
      'stab':1.05,'sync':1.00,'kick':1.30,'snare':1.15,'clap':1.15,'hatc':1.4,'fato':1.3,
      'shak':1.5,'hit':1.4,'tom':1.2,'ltom':1.2,'crash':1.5,'riser':1.6,'swell':1.0}

def tie(notes):
    """(row,note,dur) -> cells with note and keyoff"""
    ev=[]
    for r,n,d in notes:
        ev.append(('n',r,n,d))
    return ev

class Builder:
    def __init__(self, chans):
        self.chans=chans          # dict name->channel index
        self.patterns=[]          # list of (list of cells) per pattern; cells: (row,ch,note,inst,vol,off?)
        self.order=[]
    def new_pattern(self):
        self.patterns.append([])
        return len(self.patterns)-1
    def add(self,pat,row,ch,note,inst,v,off=None):
        self.patterns[pat].append((row,ch,note,inst,v))
        if off is not None:
            self.patterns[pat].append((row+off,ch,97,0,0))
    def bar_events(self, pat, bar_in_pat, ev, ch, inst, trim, sustain=False):
        """ev: list of (row,note,amp) single shots  or (row,note,dur) for sustained"""
        off=bar_in_pat*ROWS
        for e in ev:
            r,n,a=e[0],e[1],e[2]
            v=vol(a,TRIM[inst] if inst in TRIM else 1.0)
            if v<=0: continue
            if len(e)>3:      # sustained with duration
                d=e[3]
                self.add(pat,off+r,ch,n,inst,v,off=min(d,ROWS-r))
            else:
                self.add(pat,off+r,ch,n,inst,v)
PYEOF
echo ok

def section(bars, prog, bass=None, sub=None, pad=None, arp=None, arp2=None, lead=None,
            lead2=None, stab=None, drum=None, fills=None, fx=None, perc=None):

        if lead:
            mel,amp,ch,instd,tr = lead if not isinstance(lead,list) else lead[n%len(lead)]

        if lead2:

# single-shot pluck arps (no keyoff - shots decay naturally)
def plucks(bars, prog, shape, octv, amp, ch='stab', inst='arp'):
    for b in bars:
        p=note_cell(b); off=loc(b)*ROWS
        ev = arp_8th(prog,b%8,shape,octv)
        for r,n,v in ev:
            p.note(off+r, CHAN[ch], n, INST[inst], V(amp*v/42.0,inst))
plucks(BARS(42,48),'D','ud',1,30,'stab','arp')

PYEOF
cd /workspace/build && python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build'); import build_module as B
print('cells',sum(len(p.cells) for p in B.P))"

import numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
with wave.open('/workspace/build/tune.wav','rb') as f:
    nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); d=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x=d[:,0]; y=d[:,1]
bar=4*60/140
print("dur %.2f expect %.2f  | max LR diff %.3f"%(x.size/sr, 72*bar, float(np.max(np.abs(x-y)))))
rows=[]
for k in range(72):
    a=int(k*bar*sr); b=min(int((k+1)*bar*sr),x.size)
    s=x[a:b]
    if s.size<100: continue
    rows.append((k,float(np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2))),float(np.max(np.abs(s))),float(np.mean(np.abs(s)>0.99))))
import sys
for k,rms,pk,cl in rows:
    if k%2==0: print("bar %2d rms %.3f peak %.3f clip %.4f"%(k,rms,pk,cl))
print("overall clip frac %.5f  rms %.3f"%(np.mean(np.abs(x)>0.99), np.sqrt(np.mean(x**2))))
EOF"}

import numpy as np, wave
with wave.open('/workspace/build/tune.wav','rb') as f:
    sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x=d[:,0]
bar=4*60/140
print("nch",nch,"dur %.2f"%(x.size/sr))
for k in range(0,72,2):
    a=int(k*bar*sr); b=int((k+1)*bar*sr)
    s=x[a:b]
    print("bar %2d rms %.3f pk %.3f"%(k,np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2)),np.max(np.abs(s))),end=' | ')
print()
print("global rms %.3f  clipfrac %.5f  peak %.3f"%(np.sqrt(np.mean(x**2)),np.mean(np.abs(x)>0.99),np.max(np.abs(x))))
# section-level
for a,b,lab in [(0,2,"sub-only"),(2,4,"bass-in"),(4,8,"intro-lead"),(8,16,"verse"),(16,24,"pre"),
                (24,32,"chorus1"),(32,40,"chorus2"),(40,48,"solo"),(48,56,"bridge"),(56,64,"final"),(64,72,"outro")]:
    s=x[int(a*bar*sr):int(b*bar*sr)]

    def e(lo,hi):

    tot=sum(e(*bb) for bb in [(20,140),(140,450),(450,1800),(1800,7000),(7000,20000)])
    bands=[round(e(*bb)/tot,3) for bb in [(20,140),(140,450),(450,1800),(1800,7000),(7000,20000)]]
    print("%-10s rms %.3f pk %.3f  spectrum lo/mid/hi: %s"%(lab,np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2)),np.max(np.abs(s)),bands))
EOF"}

        cmds.append(("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":p,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":45,"instrument":1,"volume":40}))
    json.dump([{"name":n,"arguments":a} for n,a in cmds],open('/workspace/build/_s.json','w'))

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
import numpy as np, wave, json, subprocess
def meas(speed,bpm,rows=24,npat=1):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"sp"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"B"}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/samples/b_fat.wav","instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":0,"loop_length":5070,"flags":3,"volume":64}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":speed,"bpm":bpm,"length":npat,"loop_start":0})]
    for p in range(npat):
        cmds.append(("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":p,"rows":rows}))
        cmds.append(("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":p,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":45,"instrument":1,"volume":40}))
    json.dump([{"name":n,"arguments":a} for n,a in cmds],open('/workspace/build/_s.json','w'))
    subprocess.run(['ft2','batch','/workspace/build/_s.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    subprocess.run(['ft2','call','module_render',json.dumps({"path":"/workspace/build/sp.wav","rate":44100,"bits":16,"loops":0,"amp":16})],capture_output=True,text=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/sp.wav','rb') as f:
        nf=f.getnframes(); sr=f.getframerate()
    return nf/sr
for speed in [1,2,4,6,8]:
    d=meas(speed,140)
    print("speed %d bpm 140: dur %.3f -> row %.4f | rows*pats=%d"%(speed,d,d/(24),24))
for bpm in [100,140,200,250]:
    d=meas(8,bpm)
    print("speed 8 bpm %d: dur %.3f row %.4f"%(bpm,d,d/24))
EOF

for t in ons:
    if t-last>0.06: cl.append(t)
    last=t

actions.command:
cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import numpy as np, wave
with wave.open('/workspace/build/tune.wav','rb') as f:
    sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x=d[:,0]
# lowpass-ish energy of the whole mix; find kick transients in the intro (bars 0-8)
env=np.sqrt((x[:int(20*sr)]**2))
# simple onset: positive derivative peaks
e=np.convolve(env,np.ones(64)/64,'same')
de=np.diff(e)
th=np.percentile(de[de>0],99.5)
ons=np.nonzero(de>th)[0]/sr
# cluster
cl=[]; last=-1
for t in ons:
    if t-last>0.06: cl.append(t)
    last=t
print("onsets (s):", np.round(cl[:30],3))
print("diffs:", np.round(np.diff(cl[:20]),4))
EOF

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && cat > analyze.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np, wave, json, sys
SR=44100
def load(path='/workspace/build/tune.wav'):
    with wave.open(path,'rb') as f:
        sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    return d.reshape(-1,nch), sr
def band_db(x,sr,a,b,lo,hi):
    s=x[int(a*sr):int(b*sr)]
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(s.size))); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(s.size,1/sr)
    def e(lo2,hi2):
        m=(fr>=lo2)&(fr<hi2); return 20*np.log10(F[m].sum()+1e-9)
    return [round(e(*bb),1) for bb in [(20,140),(140,450),(450,1800),(1800,7000),(7000,20000)]]
def peaks(x,sr,a,b,n=12,fmin=40):
    s=x[int(a*sr):int(b*sr)]
    N=s.size
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(N),4*N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(4*N,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=fmin)&(fr<=4000); Fm=np.where(m,F,0)
    out=[]
    for i in np.argsort(Fm)[::-1][:400]:
        f=float(fr[i])
        if any(abs(f-p[0])<3 for p in out): continue
        out.append((round(f,1),round(float(Fm[i]/Fm.max()),3)))
        if len(out)>=n: break
    return sorted(out)
def notehz(n): return 440*2**((n-69)/12)
if __name__=='__main__':
    d,sr=load(); x=d[:,0]
    bar=4*60/140
    print("dur %.2f  rms %.3f  pk %.3f  clip %.6f"%(x.size/sr,np.sqrt(np.mean(x**2)),np.max(np.abs(x)),np.mean(np.abs(x)>0.985)))
    # kick onset spacing over first 8 bars
    env=np.abs(x)
    k=np.ones(int(0.004*sr))/int(0.004*sr)
    e=np.convolve(env,k,'same')
    de=np.diff(e); th=np.percentile(de[de>0],99.9)
    ons=np.nonzero(de>th)[0]/sr
    cl=[];last=-1
    for t in ons:
        if t-last>0.08: cl.append(t)
        last=t
    print("first 24 onsets:", np.round(cl[:24],3))
    dif=np.diff(cl[:24]); print("spacings:", np.round(dif,3))
    print("expect beat 0.4286, bar 1.714, half 0.857")
    # tuning: verse bar 8 (chord Am) spectral peaks
    print("bars 8-9 peaks:", peaks(x,sr,8*bar,10*bar))
    print("Am chord: A2=%0.1f C3=%0.1f E3=%0.1f A3=%0.1f C4=%0.1f E4=%0.1f A4=%0.1f"%(notehz(45),notehz(48),notehz(52),notehz(57),notehz(60),notehz(64),notehz(69)))
    # loop point continuity
    tail=x[-int(0.02*sr):]; head=x[:int(0.02*sr)]
    print("end rms %.4f start rms %.4f  end max %.4f"%(np.sqrt(np.mean(tail**2)),np.sqrt(np.mean(head**2)),np.max(np.abs(tail))))
    jumps=np.abs(np.diff(x))
    big=np.nonzero(jumps>0.25)[0]/sr
    print("big jumps (>0.25) count",big.size, np.round(big[:12],3))
    for lab,a,b in [("intro",0,4),("verse",8,16),("pre",16,24),("chorus",24,32),("solo",40,48),("bridge",48,56),("final",56,64),("outro",64,72)]:
        print("%-8s dB bands(lo,lm,h,rm,hi): %s"%(lab, band_db(x,sr,a*bar,b*bar,0,0)))
EOF
python3 analyze.py"}

def load(path='/workspace/build/tune.wav'):
    with wave.open(path,'rb') as f:
        sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    return d.reshape(-1,nch), sr
def band_db(x,sr,a,b,lo,hi):
    s=x[int(a*sr):int(b*sr)]
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(s.size))); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(s.size,1/sr)
    def e(lo2,hi2):
        m=(fr>=lo2)&(fr<hi2); return 20*np.log10(F[m].sum()+1e-9)
    return [round(e(*bb),1) for bb in [(20,140),(140,450),(450,1800),(1800,7000),(7000,20000)]]
def peaks(x,sr,a,b,n=12,fmin=40):
    s=x[int(a*sr):int(b*sr)]
    N=s.size
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(N),4*N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(4*N,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=fmin)&(fr<=4000); Fm=np.where(m,F,0)
    out=[]
    for i in np.argsort(Fm)[::-1][:400]:
        f=float(fr[i])
        if any(abs(f-p[0])<3 for p in out): continue
        out.append((round(f,1),round(float(Fm[i]/Fm.max()),3)))

    # kick onset spacing over first 8 bars
    env=np.abs(x)
    k=np.ones(int(0.004*sr))/int(0.004*sr)

    for lab,a,b in [("intro",0,4),("verse",8,16),("pre",16,24),("chorus",24,32),("solo",40,48),("bridge",48,56),("final",56,64),("outro",64,72)]:

import numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
with wave.open('/workspace/build/tune.wav','rb') as f:
    sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
x=d[:,0]
bar=4*60/140
FREF=260.9*2**((69-61)/12)  # A3 in my naming (i('A-4')=58?) let's derive: note n -> 260.95*2^((n-61)/12)
def notehz(n): return 260.95*2**((n-61)/12)
def spectrum(a,b,flo=60,fhi=1400,thresh=0.10):
    s=x[int(a*sr):int(b*sr)]
    N=s.size
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(N),8*N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(8*N,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=flo)&(fr<=fhi); Fm=np.where(m,F,0)
    mx=Fm.max(); out=[]
    for i in np.argsort(Fm)[::-1][:3000]:
        f=float(fr[i])
        if any(abs(f-p)<6 for p in out): continue
        out.append(round(f,1))
        if len(out)>=16: break
    return sorted(out)
def nearest_note(f):
    n=61+12*np.log2(f/260.95)
    return round(n), abs(n-round(n))
for lab,a,b,expect in [("verse bars8-9",8,10,None),("chorus bars24-25",24,26,None)]:
    sp=spectrum(a*bar,b*bar)
    print(lab)
    for f in sp:
        n,e=nearest_note(f)
        print("   %7.1f Hz -> note %2d (err %.2f semis)"%(f,n,e))

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && cat > bal.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np, wave
def load(path='/workspace/build/tune.wav'):
    with wave.open(path,'rb') as f:
        sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch)
    return d[:,0] if nch==1 else d.mean(axis=1)*0+d[:,0], d[:,1], sr
def bp(x,sr,lo,hi,order=2):
    """butterworth-ish bandpass via cascaded one-poles (fast, good enough for analysis)"""
    def lpf(x,c):
        y=np.empty_like(x); a=0.0
        for i in range(x.size):
            a+=c*(x[i]-a); y[i]=a
        return y
    h=lpf(x,np.exp(-2*np.pi*lo/sr)) - lpf(x,np.exp(-2*np.pi*hi/sr))
    return h
def bandpow(x,sr,lo,hi):
    f=np.fft.rfft(x*np.hanning(x.size)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(x.size,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=lo)&(fr<hi)
    return float(np.sqrt(np.sum(np.abs(f[m])**2))/x.size*2)
BANDS=[(20,100),(100,250),(250,700),(700,2000),(2000,5500),(5500,14000)]
def report(path='/workspace/build/tune.wav',label=""):
    x,y,sr=load(path)
    bar=4*60/140
    print(label,"mono check: L rms %.3f R rms %.3f"%(np.sqrt(np.mean(x**2)),np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))))
    secs=[(0,2),(2,4),(4,8),(8,16),(16,24),(24,32),(32,40),(40,48),(48,56),(56,64),(64,68),(68,72)]
    names=['sub-drone','bass-in','intro','VERSE','PRE','CHOR1','CHOR2','SOLO','BRIDGE','FINAL','OUT1','OUT2']
    for (a,b),nm in zip(secs,names):
        s=x[int(a*bar*sr):int(b*bar*sr)]
        pw=[bandpow(s,sr,lo,hi) for lo,hi in BANDS]
        mx=max(pw) or 1
        print("%-10s rms %.3f | %s"%(nm,np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2))," ".join("%5.1f"%(20*np.log10(p/mx+1e-9)) for p in pw)))
    # beat grid via low band envelope autocorrelation
    lo=bp(x,sr,20,120)
    e=np.abs(lo[:int(60*bar*sr)])
    ec=e-e.mean()
    c=np.correlate(ec,ec,'full')[ec.size-1:]
    peaks=[]
    for L in range(int(0.2*sr),int(2.2*sr)):
        if c[L]>c[L-1] and c[L]>=c[L+1] and c[L]>0.12*c[0]:
            peaks.append((round(L/sr,4),round(c[L]/c[0],3)))
    print("envelope periodicities (s,ratio):",peaks[:8])
if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys; report(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '/workspace/build/tune.wav',"TUNE")
EOF

import numpy as np, wave
def load(path='/workspace/build/tune.wav'):
    with wave.open(path,'rb') as f:
        sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch)
    return d[:,0] if nch==1 else d.mean(axis=1)*0+d[:,0], d[:,1], sr
def bp(x,sr,lo,hi,order=2):
    """butterworth-ish bandpass via cascaded one-poles (fast, good enough for analysis)"""
    def lpf(x,c):
        y=np.empty_like(x); a=0.0
        for i in range(x.size):
            a+=c*(x[i]-a); y[i]=a
        return y
    h=lpf(x,np.exp(-2*np.pi*lo/sr)) - lpf(x,np.exp(-2*np.pi*hi/sr))
    return h
def bandpow(x,sr,lo,hi):
    f=np.fft.rfft(x*np.hanning(x.size)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(x.size,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=lo)&(fr<hi)
    return float(np.sqrt(np.sum(np.abs(f[m])**2))/x.size*2)
BANDS=[(20,100),(100,250),(250,700),(700,2000),(2000,5500),(5500,14000)]
def report(path='/workspace/build/tune.wav',label=""):
    x,y,sr=load(path)
    bar=4*60/140
    print(label,"mono check: L rms %.3f R rms %.3f"%(np.sqrt(np.mean(x**2)),np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))))
    secs=[(0,2),(2,4),(4,8),(8,16),(16,24),(24,32),(32,40),(40,48),(48,56),(56,64),(64,68),(68,72)]
    names=['sub-drone','bass-in','intro','VERSE','PRE','CHOR1','CHOR2','SOLO','BRIDGE','FINAL','OUT1','OUT2']
    for (a,b),nm in zip(secs,names):
        s=x[int(a*bar*sr):int(b*bar*sr)]
        pw=[bandpow(s,sr,lo,hi) for lo,hi in BANDS]
        mx=max(pw) or 1
        print("%-10s rms %.3f | %s"%(nm,np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2))," ".join("%5.1f"%(20*np.log10(p/mx+1e-9)) for p in pw)))
    # beat grid via low band envelope autocorrelation
    lo=bp(x,sr,20,120)
    e=np.abs(lo[:int(60*bar*sr)])
    ec=e-e.mean()
    c=np.correlate(ec,ec,'full')[ec.size-1:]
    peaks=[]
    for L in range(int(0.2*sr),int(2.2*sr)):
        if c[L]>c[L-1] and c[L]>=c[L+1] and c[L]>0.12*c[0]:
            peaks.append((round(L/sr,4),round(c[L]/c[0],3)))
    print("envelope periodicities (s,ratio):",peaks[:8])
if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys; report(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '/workspace/build/tune.wav',"TUNE")

import numpy as np, wave
def load(path):
    with wave.open(path,'rb') as f:
        sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch)
    return d[:,0], (d[:,1] if nch>1 else d[:,0]), sr
def bandrms(x,sr,lo,hi):
    F=np.fft.rfft(x); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x),1/sr)
    m=(fr>=lo)&(fr<hi); Fm=np.where(m,F,0)
    y=np.fft.irfft(Fm,len(x))
    return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))+1e-12)

So the "stereo" field is actually a balance control between L-only and L+R. That's why my mix has L rms 0.196 and R rms 0.114 — everything is left-heavy.

To get a balanced mix, I want a mixdown whose mono sum sounds good and whose stereo image is not lopsided. Given pan=0 → L only, pan=127 → equal L/R, the practical approach: use pan values spread 100-127 for a gentle width with roughly balanced level? Hmm.

Let's compute: for pan p, amplitude L(p) ≈ 0.0974*(1 - k*p) etc. Ratio L/(L+R) goes from 1.0 at p=0 to 0.5 at p=127. The R channel amplitude goes 0 → 0.069 (i.e. R ≈ L * p/127 roughly). So R = L * (p/127) approximately? Check p=64: L 0.0844, R 0.0487 → ratio 0.577, not 0.5. p=112: 0.0645/0.0731=0.88. So R/L rises roughly linearly 0→1 across 0→127 with some offset: at 64, 0.58; at 8, 0.18.

Also note L amplitude decreases with p: 0.0974 → 0.0692 (about -3.4dB total).

So to keep channels balanced in level, I should set pan near 127 for most things — but then it's essentially mono. Alternative: keep the L/R difference small (p ≈ 110-127) so image is centred, and accept slight width variation. Given a trusted process renders the final XM (and the render is effectively "L = full, R = attenuated copy"), the safest musical choice is pan ≈ 120-127 for everything, i.e. nearly mono, with only a few elements at 100-110 for subtle width. If instead I spread across the full range, the mix sounds strongly left-tilted.

Good: so loudness is preserved regardless of pan. A listener with both speakers hears constant power; the image shifts. But my L/R rms imbalance means it sounds left-tilted on speakers. With everything at p=64, L is ~1.5x R (-4dB) → mild left tilt.

The pragmatic approach: use p in a range where the L/R balance is not too extreme, e.g. 80..127, and treat the whole thing as roughly centred. Elements at 84-104 would appear slightly left/centre. Let me instead spread the percussive/hi elements at 96-127 and keep bass/kick/lead at 127 (centre). That gives a mostly centred image with subtle width, and mono-compatibility is fine either way.

Let me set pans accordingly: centre-ish 118-127 for most, and use lower values only for a few "left" elements. But the effect of lower pan is: more left AND more overall level in left. Hmm, since power constant, moving an element to 0 makes it louder in L, silent in R. That's just hard-left. Fine.

Given the weird law, an interesting option: to get a "right-panned" element, I can't. So best musical result = keep everything near 127 (balanced L/R), giving a clean centred mix; a bit of variety by 110-127.

I'll set: most instruments 127; harpsi 112 (slightly left); steel 118; soft 116; fato 120. And keep kick/snare/bass/lead/pad at 127. The L/R rms will then be well balanced.

Now about the spectral balance: bands relative (in dB) look like: sub -3, low-mid -9, high-mid -6, presence 0 (reference peak), highs -2, extreme highs -2. The presence band (2-5.5k) dominates. Bass at -9.5 relative to presence is a bit thin for a keygen dance track; but this is measured as sum of |F| over band — a wide band accumulates more. So relative numbers across bands aren't a perfect loudness proxy. Let me instead measure per-band RMS via FFT-filtered time-domain signals (proper), and compare.

Let me do a proper band-power measure using FFT masking (inverse FFT), for a few sections, to get actual dB differences.

Also I want to check: does the kick read? Let me measure the transient pattern at 20-100 Hz and check the beat grid: earlier, my onsets were irregular because I used a crude percentile threshold on the full mix.

Also fix the bal.py bug. Let me write a better analysis tool that does:
1. Band RMS via FFT masking (1/3-octave-ish) for sections.
2. Kick detection: energy in 30-90 Hz, find peaks, check spacing = 0.857 s (every 2 beats) etc.
3. Loop check: end-of-song vs start.

Then adjust arrangement/levels and finalize.

Time: 31 min left. Let me be efficient: one script that does analysis + one that regenerates. I need to reserve ~10 min for final save and sanity check of submission files.

import numpy as np, wave
def load(path):
    with wave.open(path,'rb') as f:
        sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch)
    return d[:,0], (d[:,1] if nch>1 else d[:,0]), sr
def bandrms(x,sr,lo,hi):
    F=np.fft.rfft(x); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x),1/sr)
    m=(fr>=lo)&(fr<hi); Fm=np.where(m,F,0)
    y=np.fft.irfft(Fm,len(x))
    return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))+1e-12)
BANDS=[(20,70),(70,150),(150,400),(400,1200),(1200,3500),(3500,9000),(9000,20000)]
LBL=['sub','bass','lowmid','mid','upper','pres','air']
def report(path,secs=None,name="mix"):
    x,y,sr=load(path)
    bar=4*60/140
    if secs is None: secs=[(0,2,'drone'),(4,8,'intro'),(8,16,'verse'),(24,32,'chorus'),(48,56,'bridge'),(56,64,'final'),(68,72,'outro')]
    print("%s: dur %.2f  Lrms %.3f Rrms %.3f  peak %.3f clip %.5f"%(name,x.size/sr,np.sqrt(np.mean(x**2)),np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2)),np.max(np.abs(x)),np.mean(np.abs(x)>0.985)))
    print("      "+" ".join("%8s"%l for l in LBL))
    for a,b,lab in secs:
        s=x[int(a*bar*sr):int(b*bar*sr)]
        pw=[bandrms(s,sr,lo,hi) for lo,hi in BANDS]
        ref=pw[3]
        print("%-8s "%lab+" ".join("%8.1f"%(20*np.log10(p/ref)) for p in pw)+"   rms %.3f"%np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2)))
    # kick grid: envelope of 30-90 Hz band
    F=np.fft.rfft(x); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x),1/sr)

    import collections
    print("spacing histogram:",dict(collections.Counter(np.round(dif,2))))

Actually let me reconsider the grid resolution. Standard for this style: 16th-note grid. At 140 BPM, 16th = 0.107 s. Also with 1 bar = 1 pattern, structure is easier to reason about (and each pattern can be unique → more variety, less repetition).

However, more patterns = more cells to emit (fine) but pattern rows 16 → 72 patterns. Order length 72. Loop start 0. Total duration unchanged.

- melodies: durations in 16ths (4 = quarter, 2 = 8th, 6 = dotted quarter, 8 = half)

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && cat > check.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np, wave, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
def load(path='/workspace/build/tune.wav'):
    with wave.open(path,'rb') as f:
        sr=f.getframerate(); nch=f.getnchannels(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch)
    return d[:,0], d[:,1], sr
def bandpass(x,sr,lo,hi,a,b):
    s=x[int(a*sr):int(b*sr)]
    n=len(s); N=1<<int(np.ceil(np.log2(n)))
    F=np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(n),N); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=lo)&(fr<=hi)
    return fr[m], np.abs(F[m])
def toppeaks(fr,F,n=6,mind=5.0):
    out=[]
    for i in np.argsort(F)[::-1]:
        f=float(fr[i])
        if any(abs(f-p)<mind for p in out): continue
        out.append(f)
        if len(out)>=n: break
    return sorted(out)
def engine_hz(n): return 260.95*2**((n-61)/12)
if __name__=='__main__':
    import build_module as B, song
    x,y,sr=load()
    bar=4*60/140
    print("=== bass root check (bars 8..16 verse, prog A) ===")
    for b in range(8,16):
        fr,F=bandpass(x,sr,40,180,b*bar,(b+1)*bar)
        pk=toppeaks(fr,F,4,4.0)
        ch,qq,root,tri=song.chord_notes('A',b)
        want=engine_hz(root)
        print(" bar %2d chord %s expect root %.1f Hz  measured %s"%(b,ch,want,[round(p,1) for p in pk]))
    print("=== lead melody check: bars 24-26 chorus, 300-1400 Hz peaks ===")
    for b in range(24,28):
        fr,F=bandpass(x,sr,250,1500,b*bar,b*bar+bar*0.5)
        pk=toppeaks(fr,F,8,8.0)
        notes=[(n) for r,n,d in song.lead_events('C',song.CHORUS_LEAD,b)]
        print(" bar %d: peaks %s"%(b,[round(p,1) for p in pk]))
        print("        lead notes %s"%([round(engine_hz(n),1) for n in notes]))
    print("=== kick grid: onsets in bars 24-32 (low band 25-95) ===")
    fr,F=bandpass(x,sr,25,95,24*bar,32*bar)
    n=int(8*bar*sr)
    seg=x[int(24*bar*sr):int(32*bar*sr)]
    N=1<<int(np.ceil(np.log2(len(seg)))); SS=np.fft.rfft(seg,N); frr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
    m=(frr>=25)&(frr<95); SSf=np.where(m,SS,0); k=np.fft.irfft(SSf,N)[:len(seg)]
    ds=int(sr/500); nn=len(k)//ds
    e=np.abs(k[:nn*ds]).reshape(nn,ds).mean(1)
    de=np.diff(e); th=np.percentile(de,99.2)
    ons=np.nonzero(de>th)[0]/500.0
    cl=[];last=-1
    for t in ons:
        if t-last>0.09: cl.append(t)
        last=t
    dif=np.round(np.diff(cl),3)
    import collections
    print(" onsets",len(cl),"spacings hist",dict(sorted(collections.Counter(dif).items())))
    print(" 16th=%.3f 8th=%.3f beat=%.3f bar=%.3f"%(bar/16,bar/8,bar/4,bar))
EOF

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
import json, subprocess, numpy as np, wave
import build_module as B
SR=44100
def render_only(keep, bars=(8,16), name="iso"):
    """build commands that emit only channels whose name in keep"""
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":20,"name":name})]
    e=open('/workspace/build/emit.py').read()
    # reuse instrument setup from cmds.json
    all_cmds=json.load(open('/workspace/build/cmds.json'))
    setup=[c for c in all_cmds if c['name'] in ('module_new','instrument_set','sample_load','sample_set','song_set','order_set')]
    keepch={B.CHAN[k] for k in keep}
    pat=[]
    for pi,p in enumerate(B.P):
        pat.append({"name":"pattern_set_length","arguments":{"pattern":pi,"rows":B.HALF}})
        for (row,ch,note,inst,v) in p.cells:
            if ch in keepch:
                pat.append({"name":"pattern_set_cell","arguments":{"pattern":pi,"row":row,"channel":ch,"note":int(note),"instrument":int(inst) if inst else 0,"volume":int(v)}})
    cmds=[(c['name'],c['arguments']) for c in setup+pat]
    for i in range(0,len(cmds),1500):
        json.dump([{"name":n,"arguments":a} for n,a in cmds[i:i+1500]],open('/workspace/build/_i.json','w'))
        subprocess.run(['ft2','batch','/workspace/build/_i.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    subprocess.run(['ft2','call','module_render',json.dumps({"path":"/workspace/build/%s.wav"%name,"rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0,"amp":16})],capture_output=True,text=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/%s.wav'%name,'rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch)
    return d[:,0], sr
def note_hz(n): return 440*2**((n-69)/12)*2  # our naming: idx A-4=58 -> 220 Hz
def engine_hz(n): return 260.95*2**((n-61)/12)
def peaks_in(x,sr,t0,t1,lo,hi,n=8):
    s=x[int(t0*sr):int(t1*sr)]
    N=1<<int(np.ceil(np.log2(len(s)*4)))
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(len(s)),N)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=lo)&(fr<=hi); Fm=np.where(m,F,0)
    out=[]
    for i in np.argsort(Fm)[::-1]:
        f=float(fr[i])
        if any(abs(f-p)<3.5 for p in out): continue
        out.append(round(f,1))
        if len(out)>=n: break
    return sorted(out)
if __name__=='__main__':
    import song
    bar=4*60/140
    x,sr=render_only(['bass'],name='iso_bass')
    for b in range(8,12):
        ch,q,root,tri=song.chord_notes('A',b)
        print("bar %d bass chord %s root expect %.1f  peaks %s"%(b,ch,engine_hz(root),peaks_in(x,sr,b*bar,(b+1)*bar,40,200,5)))
    y,sr=render_only(['lead'],name='iso_lead')
    for b in range(8,12):
        ev=song.lead_events('A',song.VERSE_LEAD,b)
        exp=[round(engine_hz(n),1) for r,n,d in ev]
        print("bar %d lead expect %s  peaks %s"%(b,exp,peaks_in(y,sr,b*bar,b*bar+bar*0.49,150,900,5)))
EOF

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
import json, subprocess, numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
def one(sample, note, rel=0, ls=0, ll=0, volc=48, rows=64):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"pitch"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"X"}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/samples/"+sample,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":ls,"loop_length":ll,"flags":3 if ll else 0,"volume":64,"relative_note":rel}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":rows}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":note,"instrument":1,"volume":volc}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/pitch.wav","rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0,"amp":16})]
    json.dump([{"name":n,"arguments":a} for n,a in cmds],open('/workspace/build/_pp.json','w'))
    subprocess.run(['ft2','batch','/workspace/build/_pp.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/pitch.wav','rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x=d[:,0]
    s=x[int(1.0*sr):int(3.0*sr)]
    N=len(s); M=1<<int(np.ceil(np.log2(16*N)))
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(N),M)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(M,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=20)&(fr<=4200); Fm=np.where(m,F,0)
    i=int(np.argmax(Fm))
    # parabolic
    a,b,c=Fm[i-1],Fm[i],Fm[i+1]
    dd=0.5*(a-c)/(a-2*b+c) if (a-2*b+c)!=0 else 0
    return float(fr[i])+dd*(fr[1]-fr[0])
def eng(n,base=260.95): return base*2**((n-61)/12)
import json as J
man=J.load(open('/workspace/build/manifest.json'))
for samp,notes in [('b_fat.wav',[34,46,58,70,82]),('l_fat.wav',[58,70,82]),('p_soft.wav',[61,73]),('b_sync.wav',[34,46])]:
    m=None
    for k,v in man['tonal'].items():
        if v['file']==samp: m=v
    print(samp,"loop",m['ls'],m['ll'])
    for n in notes:
        f=one(samp,n,m['rel'],m['ls'],m['ll'])
        print("   note %2d expect %8.2f got %8.2f  err %+7.1f cents"%(n,eng(n),f,1200*np.log2(f/eng(n))))
EOF"}

cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
import json, subprocess, numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
def one(sample, note, rel=0, ls=0, ll=0, volc=48, rows=64):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"pitch"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"X"}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/samples/"+sample,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":ls,"loop_length":ll,"flags":3 if ll else 0,"volume":64,"relative_note":rel}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":rows}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":note,"instrument":1,"volume":volc}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/pitch.wav","rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0,"amp":16})]
    json.dump([{"name":n,"arguments":a} for n,a in cmds],open('/workspace/build/_pp.json','w'))
    subprocess.run(['ft2','batch','/workspace/build/_pp.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/pitch.wav','rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); x=d[:,0]
    s=x[int(1.0*sr):int(3.0*sr)]
    N=len(s); M=1<<int(np.ceil(np.log2(16*N)))
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(N),M)); fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(M,1/sr)
    m=(fr>=20)&(fr<=4200); Fm=np.where(m,F,0)
    i=int(np.argmax(Fm))
    # parabolic
    a,b,c=Fm[i-1],Fm[i],Fm[i+1]
    dd=0.5*(a-c)/(a-2*b+c) if (a-2*b+c)!=0 else 0
    return float(fr[i])+dd*(fr[1]-fr[0])
def eng(n,base=260.95): return base*2**((n-61)/12)
import json as J
man=J.load(open('/workspace/build/manifest.json'))
for samp,notes in [('b_fat.wav',[34,46,58,70,82]),('l_fat.wav',[58,70,82]),('p_soft.wav',[61,73]),('b_sync.wav',[34,46])]:
    m=None
    for k,v in man['tonal'].items():
        if v['file']==samp: m=v
    print(samp,"loop",m['ls'],m['ll'])
    for n in notes:
        f=one(samp,n,m['rel'],m['ls'],m['ll'])
        print("   note %2d expect %8.2f got %8.2f  err %+7.1f cents"%(n,eng(n),f,1200*np.log2(f/eng(n))))
EOF

cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
import json, subprocess, numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
def render(sample, note, ls, ll, flags, volc=48, rows=48, rel=0):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"pk3"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"X"}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/samples/"+sample,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":ls,"loop_length":ll,"flags":flags,"volume":64,"relative_note":rel}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":rows}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":note,"instrument":1,"volume":volc}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/pk3.wav","rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0,"amp":16})]
    json.dump([{"name":n,"arguments":a} for n,a in cmds],open('/workspace/build/_pk.json','w'))
    subprocess.run(['ft2','batch','/workspace/build/_pk.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/pk3.wav','rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); return d[:,0], sr
def f0(x,sr,t0=1.0,t1=3.0):
    s=x[int(t0*sr):int(t1*sr)]
    n=len(s); M=1<<int(np.ceil(np.log2(20*n)))
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(n),M))/n*4; fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(M,1/sr)
    mm=(fr>15)&(fr<3000); f=fr[mm]; g=F[mm]
    idx=np.argsort(g)[::-1][:200]; pk=[]
    for i in idx:
        fq=float(f[i])
        if any(abs(fq-p[0])<2.5 for p in pk): continue
        pk.append(round(fq,2))
        if len(pk)>=6: break
    return sorted(pk), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2)))
def eng(n): return 260.95*2**((n-61)/12)
for note in [58,70]:
    for ls,ll,fl,tag in [(0,5070,3,"loop all"),(0,1690,3,"loop 10cyc"),(0,169,3,"loop 1cyc"),
                          (169,1690,3,"loop 10cyc@169"),(0,0,0,"no loop"),(0,5070,1,"flag=1")]:
        pk,rms=f0(*render('b_fat.wav',note,ls,ll,fl))
        print("note %2d %-16s expect %8.2f | peaks %s rms %.4f"%(note,tag,eng(note),pk,rms))
EOF

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
import json, subprocess, numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
def render(sample, note, ls, ll, flags, volc=48, rows=48, rel=0):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"pk3"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"X"}),("sample_load",{"path":"/workspace/samples/"+sample,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":ls,"loop_length":ll,"flags":flags,"volume":64,"relative_note":rel}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":rows}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":note,"instrument":1,"volume":volc}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":"/workspace/build/pk3.wav","rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0,"amp":16})]
    json.dump([{"name":n,"arguments":a} for n,a in cmds],open('/workspace/build/_pk.json','w'))
    subprocess.run(['ft2','batch','/workspace/build/_pk.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    with wave.open('/workspace/build/pk3.wav','rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); return d[:,0], sr
def f0(x,sr,t0=1.0,t1=3.0):
    s=x[int(t0*sr):int(t1*sr)]
    n=len(s); M=1<<int(np.ceil(np.log2(20*n)))
    F=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(s*np.hanning(n),M))/n*4; fr=np.fft.rfftfreq(M,1/sr)
    mm=(fr>15)&(fr<3000); fa=fr[mm]; ga=F[mm]
    idx=np.argsort(ga)[::-1][:200]; pk=[]
    for i in idx:
        fq=float(fa[i])
        if any(abs(fq-p)<2.5 for p in pk): continue
        pk.append(round(fq,2))
        if len(pk)>=6: break
    return sorted(pk), float(np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2)))
def eng(n): return 260.95*2**((n-61)/12)
for note in [58,70]:
    for ls,ll,fl,tag in [(0,5070,3,"loop all"),(0,1690,3,"loop 10cyc"),(0,169,3,"loop 1cyc"),
                          (169,1690,3,"loop@169"),(0,0,0,"no loop"),(0,5070,1,"flag=1")]:
        pk,rms=f0(*render('b_fat.wav',note,ls,ll,fl))
        print("note %2d %-12s expect %8.2f | peaks %s rms %.4f"%(note,tag,eng(note),pk,rms))
EOF"}

{"command": "cd /workspace/build && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/build')
import json, subprocess, numpy as np, wave
SR=44100
def mkring(period, n, amp=0.4, path='/workspace/build/srcA.wav'):
    """sine with exact integer period, n samples total"""
    tt=np.arange(n)
    x=amp*np.sin(2*np.pi*tt/period)
    xi=np.int16(np.round(x*32767))
    with wave.open(path,'wb') as f:
        f.setnchannels(1);f.setsampwidth(2);f.setframerate(SR);f.writeframes(xi.tobytes())
    return path
def render(path, note, ls, ll, flags, out='/workspace/build/outA.wav'):
    cmds=[("module_new",{"channels":2,"name":"mA"}),
     ("instrument_set",{"instrument":1,"name":"X"}),("sample_load",{"path":path,"instrument":1,"sample":0}),
     ("sample_set",{"instrument":1,"sample":0,"loop_start":ls,"loop_length":ll,"flags":flags,"volume":64,"relative_note":0}),
     ("pattern_set_length",{"pattern":0,"rows":48}),
     ("pattern_set_cell",{"pattern":0,"row":0,"channel":0,"note":note,"instrument":1,"volume":48}),
     ("song_set",{"speed":6,"bpm":140,"length":1,"loop_start":0}),
     ("module_render",{"path":out,"rate":SR,"bits":16,"loops":0,"amp":16})]
    json.dump([{"name":n,"arguments":a} for n,a in cmds],open('/workspace/build/_mA.json','w'))
    subprocess.run(['ft2','batch','/workspace/build/_mA.json'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    with wave.open(out,'rb') as f:
        nch=f.getnchannels(); sr=f.getframerate(); raw=f.readframes(f.getnframes())
    d=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768.0
    d=d.reshape(-1,nch); return d[:,0], sr
def per(x,sr,t0=0.5,t1=1.5):
    s=x[int(t0*sr):int(t1*sr)]
    y=s-s.mean()
    c=np.correlate(y,y,'full')[y.size-1:]; c=c/(c[0]+1e-12)
    order=np.argsort(c[3:])[::-1][:6]+3
    return [(int(L),round(float(c[L]),2)) for L in sorted(order,key=lambda L:-c[L])], float(np.sqrt(np.mean(s**2)))
print("== period 169 (=260.95 Hz @44100), vary total length; loop whole file, note 61 ==")
for n in [1690, 5070, 17640, 44100, 66150, 88200]:
    p=mkring(169,n)
    x,sr=render(p,61,0,n,3)
    L,rms=per(x,sr)
    print("  n=%6d  rms %.4f  best lags %s"%(n,rms,L[:4]))
print("== same but flags=0 no loop ==")
for n in [5070, 44100]:
    p=mkring(169,n)
    x,sr=render(p,61,0,0,0)
    L,rms=per(x,sr)
    print("  n=%6d  rms %.4f  best lags %s"%(n,rms,L[:4]))
print("== period 84 (525 Hz) long file ==")
p=mkring(84,44100); x,sr=render(p,61,0,44100,3); print("  ",per(x,sr))
print("== period 338 (130.5 Hz) long file ==")
p=mkring(338,44100); x,sr=render(p,61,0,44100,3); print("  ",per(x,sr))
EOF"}
